column1: General Rules For School Report Card Data
Data will be delivered in discrete tables, containing SEA, LEA and School level records as per business requirement.

All tables will contain at least the following keys:
 - year
 - agency_code

Masking Rules:
Count = <10
Percent = <5%, >95%
Masking will be completed by Business Area.  If Business Area is not able to mask data, RCD team will mask.
To assist in troubleshooting, data set should must indicate when element is masked.
category code included in rcd_location file
LEA and School codes should include the leading "0"
LEA and School codes must be in DPI school code format (not PowerSchool format)
